official_definition: Evil Light (When Attacks) When you use a magic card, after the effect resolves, you can activate that effect again, without paying the cost. At the end of the battle, all the Magic cards you used on this battle return to your hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Evil Light] or [Evil Light: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Evil Light]", "give [Evil Light]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
